q: What are your exact trip dates, your nightly budget ceiling and your minimum hotel quality?
have: The dashboard uses an automatic scenario: 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-13 (7 nights), selected from the captured schedule on 2026-11-19. The date choice is not traveler-provided. The budget ceiling is based on a dated, unverified booking observation, and the Luxury quality floor is a property-tier label, not an independent quality rating.
missing: The traveler’s preferred dates, budget ceiling, occupancy, and minimum quality standard are unknown. The automatic settings are scenario defaults only; the dated hotel quote used to derive the ceiling is not for the selected stay and is not a verified current rate.

q: Is any DSE IV event actually a freezeout?
have: All 37 official structure sheets were read. Under S1, 53 rows are classified 'Confirmed single-entry (standard S1)' because their own sheet contains no rule granting another entry; none of the sheets explicitly promises a one-entry maximum or uses 'freezeout' as a guarantee.
missing: A written, event-number-specific statement from the Venetian that the entry limit is one, with no re-entry, rebuy, add-on, or other paid advantage. The S1 label describes the published terms found; it is not the venue's explicit promise.
how: Ask the Venetian tournament desk for written maximum-entry/no-rebuy/no-add-on terms for each candidate event number. Until then, treat S1 as a rules-based screen rather than a guaranteed freezeout and keep the limitation visible.

q: How long will you play each event, and therefore which two events can actually be played in sequence on the same day?
